caption:
Rewriting should fix weak phrasing without inventing metrics.

In JobRez, grounded rewrites are rule-based. They replace weak openers, remove filler, and fix capitalisation and punctuation. Every single edit is listed directly, and the system never adds numbers, tools, or employers to your bullets.

Learn more at jobrez.com.
